description:
`bill` lets a seller's app charge you per use for work delivered outside the gateway, against the one enrollment you gave it a key for, at that service's own price.

The gateway answers `bill` itself (`bill://enrollment`): there is no upstream. A charge is `{"units": N, "description": ...}` with an `Idempotency-Key` from the seller's own records. The gateway checks the calling key's `service:bill` grant, takes the enrollment from the key (a key bound to that enrollment), records the charge and answers `202` with a receipt, `{"charge_id", "status": "received"}`; the receipt is the only confirmation, so sellers keep their own records. The platform then bills the charge as `units` of the enrollment's own service, at that service's price, and pays its seller, like any other call. The same `Idempotency-Key` never bills twice. `bill` moves money, so it exports three permissions and nothing else: `charge` records charges, `refund` gives units of an earlier charge back, and `query` lists the enrollment's charges with their status. `invoke`, and the `service:*` and `*` wildcards that stand for it, never reach `bill`, and only a key bound to an enrollment may hold a `service:bill` grant, so you can't be billed through a key you use yourself. The grant's `max_units_per_charge` option caps the units of one charge. `bill` itself is free.

`POST /bill` with a key bound to the enrollment whose policy grants `service:bill` with `charge`, e.g. `{"object": "service:bill", "permissions": ["charge", "query"], "options": "max_units_per_charge=5"}`, and an `Idempotency-Key` header; the answer is `202 {"charge_id": ..., "status": "received"}`. `POST /bill/refund` with `{"charge_id": ..., "units": N}` (all remaining units when omitted) and an `Idempotency-Key` gives units back with `refund`. `GET /bill` with `query` lists the enrollment's charges and refunds, newest first, with their status (`billed`, `refused`), paged by `next_cursor` passed back as `before`.

max_units_per_charge.description: The most units one charge may carry. Unset: no per-charge cap.
max_units_per_charge.title: Most units per charge

name: bill

payout_price.description: Not billed: each charge is priced by the enrollment's own service

summary: Let an app you gave a key charge you per use through `/bill`, against one of your enrollments, at that service's own price.
